text: To whoever finds this: you are doing better than you think.
The tide brought me a good day. I am sending half of it to you.
Drink some water. Roll your shoulders. The sea says hello.
If you are reading this, a crab somewhere is very proud of you.
I hid a tiny wish in here. Please keep it warm.
It rained all morning and the puddles were perfect. Go find a puddle.
Today I learned that waves take their time, and so can you.
Please enjoy this blank space. It is for your very best idea.
A seagull stole my sandwich, but I made a friend. Net win.
Somebody left the lighthouse on for you. It is a good light.
You are exactly on time for whatever you are on time for.
I counted forty shells and loved every one of them. Count yours.
Be kind to the next person you meet. They are carrying a bottle too.
The stars are very far away and still they came out for you.
I planted a sandcastle here. It is yours now. Be a good king or queen.
Sleep well, eat something warm, and tell a friend they matter.
This bottle has been to three beaches and likes yours best.
Send the next one yourself. A good message travels well.
Even the biggest wave started as a little ripple. Start small.
I wrote this with a very small pencil and a very big smile.
If today was heavy, put it down here. The sea can carry it.
The octopus says: ask for help, you have more hands than you think.
A good snack, a good song and a good friend. That is the whole secret.
Wave at a stranger today. Waves are free.
I found a perfect shell, then gave it away. Best day all week.
Your name looks great in the sand. Write it again tomorrow.
The kelp forest is swaying to a song only you can hear.
Take the long way home. The long way has the shells.
I believe in you, and so does this very damp piece of paper.
Nobody told the tide to be brave, and yet here we are.
Hello from the other side of the ocean! The weather is lovely.
A tiny crab asked me to say: you can stay as long as you like.
The moon is full tonight. Make a wish, then take a nap.
May all your puddles be shallow and your socks stay dry.
I am a message in a bottle. You are the best thing that happened to me.
Listen: the sea is saying you are allowed to rest.
There is treasure nearby, but the real treasure is the walk.
Do one small thing today and call it a win.
A starfish told me a secret. It is that you are great.
Tell somebody what you like about them. Then go and get ice cream.
This note is made of recycled kindness. Please recycle it.
The lighthouse keeper sends a cup of tea across the waves.
Remember to breathe in like the tide, and out like the tide.
I will be back at this beach next summer. Come and say hi.
A whale hummed a lullaby just now. I wrote down the notes: la la la.
Your best days are the ones with salty hair and sandy toes.
If the world is loud, come and sit by the water for a bit.
You found me. That means today is already a little bit lucky.
Keep the bottle. Fill it with something nice. Pass it on.
